SELECT mc.id AS memberCouponId, mc.coupon_id AS couponId, mc.member_id AS memberId, c.name AS couponName, mc.issued_at AS issuedAt, c.starts_at AS startsAt, c.expires_at AS expiresAt FROM member_coupons mc INNER JOIN coupons c ON c.id = mc.coupon_id WHERE mc.status = 'AVAILABLE' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.starts_at <= NOW(6) AND c.expires_at > NOW(6)
AND ( mc.issued_at > #{lastIssuedAt} OR (mc.issued_at = #{lastIssuedAt} AND mc.id > #{lastMemberCouponId}) )
AND (mc.issued_at >= #{since} OR c.starts_at >= #{since})
ORDER BY mc.issued_at ASC, mc.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM member_coupons mc INNER JOIN coupons c ON c.id = mc.coupon_id WHERE mc.id = #{memberCouponId} AND mc.status = 'AVAILABLE' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.starts_at <= NOW(6) AND c.expires_at > NOW(6)
AND c.expires_at = #{expiresAt}
